message: I remember the time the power went out right in the middle of my favorite show. I grabbed my flashlight, but then I realized my phone was almost dead, too. I rushed to find my power bank, and thankfully, I had it charged up. It’s funny how we often think about food and light during a blackout, but keeping our tech alive can be just as important. Now, I always make sure to have a backup plan for my devices, just in case. How do you keep your tech powered up during an outage?
